records.name: Vercel AI SDK core
records.one_liner: Provider-neutral generation/tool-loop primitives and UI streams; applications supply sessions, compaction and runtime ownership.
builds_on: AI SDK provider specification and provider adapters
used_by: Mastra (provider specification and bundled SDK generations)

features_notes.subagents: Agent-as-tool recipe; wrapped runtimes may provide native delegation.
features_notes.durable_resume: Optional WorkflowAgent on external Workflow DevKit; core has no persistence and durability score is 1.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Optional external sandbox providers; core does not isolate host tools.
features_notes.web_ui: UI protocols and useChat bindings, not a finished application.

dims.loop: generateText/streamText own tool loops; ToolLoopAgent is a settings wrapper defaulting to 20 steps.
dims.providers: Versioned LanguageModelV4 with V2/V3 compatibility and provider registry.
dims.tools: Typed tools, parallel execution, repair and call-level approvals; no default coding tools.
dims.context: prepareStep and pruning hooks; no built-in summary compaction or project-instruction loader.
dims.state: Core has no store; optional WorkflowAgent supports generate/stream with external workflow replay.
dims.safety: Approval validation and optional HMAC signatures; external isolation must be selected and configured.
dims.extensibility: Model middleware, callbacks, MCP and custom Agent implementations; no application plugin marketplace.
dims.multi_agent: Agent-as-tool composition; HarnessAgent delegates native features to wrapped runtimes.
dims.surfaces: In-process SDK, web UI bindings and handler helpers; no standalone HTTP server.
dims.observability: Telemetry interfaces and OTel integration package; cost generally comes from provider/Gateway metadata.
